title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
Paper signals only. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record. Every figure below is a paper figure, and a single trade says nothing about a strategy. v005 counts its live record from 1 October 2026 and v006 from 9 October 2026. The live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. ATOM exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. A NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since. In testing, losses were common and the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise. The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel.

## What is open on paper

- htf-rsi-v007: 0 positions open on paper.
- trend-daily-v005: the Bitcoin market filter is off; 0 positions open on paper.
- trend-daily-v006: the Bitcoin market filter is off; 0 positions open on paper.
- A NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since.

With the filter off, both trend engines show 0 positions open on paper, so the record contains no new trend entries from those engines. No close is recorded for the NEAR entry. htf-rsi-v007 also shows 0 positions open on paper, so every engine in this snapshot has an empty paper book. An empty book is a state, not a verdict on any engine. A reader should treat these lines as state descriptions: they say what is open now, not what should be open.

## What has closed

- htf-rsi-v007 closed trades so far: 4, average null net per trade.
- trend-daily-v005 closed trades so far: 6, average -13.22% net per trade.
- trend-daily-v006 closed trades so far: 7, average -13.34% net per trade.
- ATOM exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip.

The closed-trade averages are negative for both trend engines, while htf-rsi-v007 shows an average null net per trade across 4 closed trades. ATOM is the recorded loss from that live signal. The ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close and the exit at 1.703 at the 18 October 2026 close are the full recorded path for that signal. The loss of −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip is the measured outcome, not an estimate. The trend engines' averages of -13.22% and -13.34% are also measured from closed paper trades. These are small samples, and the record does not support a conclusion about future performance. The purpose of the record is to show what happened, not to forecast what will happen.

## Market filter and distance to breakout

- trend-daily-v005: the Bitcoin market filter is off.
- trend-daily-v006: the Bitcoin market filter is off.
- For both engines, the closest names to a 20-day breakout are TRXUSDT at 9.82% below its high, BNBUSDT at 10.43% below its high, and UNIUSDT at 12.53% below its high.

The filter being off means the engines are not recording new entries. Because the filter is off, both engines report 0 positions open on paper even though TRXUSDT, BNBUSDT, and UNIUSDT are listed as closest to a 20-day breakout. The gap between a near breakout and an open position is the filter state. The distances are measurements of how far those names are from their highs, not entry instructions. A name can be close to a breakout and still not trigger an entry if the filter remains off. The record shows the gap; it does not say when or whether that gap closes.

## Reading the live record

- Paper signals only. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record.
- The live snapshot was read at 2026-11-11T08:55:43.769Z.
- The record updates continuously.
- The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel.

A losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise, because the testing expectation was that losses would be common and the average winner would be roughly +19%.
